what_was_already_seen: the audit reproductions only: A4 (a copied held-out reading with sigma 0.5000005 instead of 0.5, or value 4.0000001 K instead of 4.0, crossed ObservationSplit), and the audit agent's (consensus of 1 m against 1000 mm: relative difference 0.999, not agreed; a cross-limit range [0.9 dimensionless, 50 percent] accepted and [50 percent, 0.9] refused)

near_duplicate_readings.rule: ObservationSplit refuses, unless exact replicates are declared, any pair across its halves with the same observable whose values differ by at most 1e-6 of the larger sigma and whose sigmas differ by at most 1e-6 relative, compared in the value's base unit
near_duplicate_readings.why: two distinct measurements of a continuous quantity agreeing to a millionth of their own uncertainty, with the same declared uncertainty to a millionth, are a copy; twelve significant digits caught only copies that were not touched
near_duplicate_readings.class: C (a declared copy-detection resolution, far below any physical measurement resolution)

consensus_in_one_unit.rule: CrossSolverConsensus.from_results expresses each named value in the unit of the first declared route that reports it before comparing; values_digest is computed over those numbers
consensus_in_one_unit.effect_on_existing_records: none where every route already reports a name in one unit, which is every committed consensus record

cross_limit_ordering_in_one_unit.rule: CrossLimitCondition orders its maximum against its minimum after converting the maximum into the minimum's unit

not_changed: ModelType and the model-level validation status stay descriptive labels that drive no decision (CORE-018, part three); nothing in the core reads them for trust, so no rule is added
amendments: recorded here as dated entries, never edited in place
